name: BOGO for WooCommerce By Virtualcode
author: Virtualcode

sections.description: BOGO for WooCommerce lets you create flexible Buy X Get Y Free offers for your WooCommerce store. Set your offer quantity, choose which products, categories, or tags are eligible, and automatically apply the free quantity in the cart and at checkout.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added core Buy X Get Y Free cart functionality.
  • Automatically applies the eligible free quantity in the cart and checkout.
  • Added support for product, category, and tag-based eligibility.
  • Added a clear “X FREE” label for free items.
  • Added automatic updates when cart quantities or contents change.
  • Added customer-facing offer messages on product pages, cart, and checkout.
  • Improved pricing and discount handling, including sale-price scenarios.
  • Improved cart recalculation to prevent stale BOGO discounts or free-item labels.
  • Improved price rounding for more accurate cart totals.
  • Added a new sticky admin header with General, Rules, Settings, and About tabs.
  • Added a Coming Soon preview for future Limits & Scheduling settings.
  • Improved WordPress.org Plugin Check compliance, security, translations, and asset handling.

1.0.0

  • Initial plugin release with the basic plugin structure and WooCommerce integration.
